theorem lg_target {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {x : K} {m n : ℕ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h'x : x < 1) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x ^ i ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) := by
  have h1 : x ≠ 1 := by intro h; rw [h] at h'x; exact lt_irrefl (1 : K) h'x
  obtain h_sum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x ^ i = (x ^ m - x ^ n) / (1 - x) :=
    geom_sum_Ico' hx h1
  have h_denom_pos : 0 < 1 - x := by rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; exact add_pos_of_nonneg_pos hx h'x
  have h_x_pow_le : x ^ n ≤ x ^ m := by apply pow_le_pow_of_le_left hx (le_refl n)
  have h_numerator_le : x ^ m - x ^ n ≤ x ^ m := by exact sub_le_self h_x_pow_le
  apply le_div_iff (le_zero_iff.mp h_denom_pos)
  exact h_numerator_le
